objective: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.

description: I will ignore your impertinence this time, <class>, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, <race>, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!
Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
progress: <name>, you're back and still alive! Well, at least that makes one of us.
You're going to have to tell me all about it!
completion: He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.
This is a great day, <name>! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.
Thank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.
